name: MediaFusion
description: MediaFusion is a Stremio add-on service that aggregates scraping sources and requires PostgreSQL and Redis backends, with optional Prowlarr and Browserless integrations.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Host port mapped to MediaFusion (container listens on 8000).

variables.name: Host URL
variables.description: Public URL users will access (include scheme, no trailing slash).

variables.name: Poster Host URL
variables.description: Public URL used for poster/image endpoints. Usually same as HOST_URL.

variables.name: Contact Email
variables.description: Contact email exposed in add-on metadata.

variables.name: Prowlarr URL
variables.description: Optional but recommended Prowlarr endpoint for indexer integration.

variables.name: Scrapling CDP URL
variables.description: Browserless websocket endpoint for scraping tasks.

variables.name: Single Worker Mode
variables.description: Use one consolidated queue worker mode (default upstream compose behavior).

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: Required security key. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 16

variables.name: API Password
variables.description: API password required by the app for securing endpoints.

variables.name: Read Replica URI
variables.description: Optional PostgreSQL read-replica connection string for HA deployments.
